services.desc: Experience the thrill of parasailing with Channel Islands Parasail and Santa Barbara Parasail, now united to offer you the ultimate adventure! All flights are currently departing from our beautiful Santa Barbara location, just a short ride up the coast in one of the most iconic beach cities in the world. Soar above stunning coastal views and make unforgettable memories with the best parasailing experience in Southern California. Come fly with us

blurb: Guests experience parasailing flights departing from Santa Barbara, soaring above coastal views. The business offers both public and private parasailing flights. Flights provide thrilling aerial views and memorable adventures along the Southern California coast.
